brms's block draws its thresholds unsorted (rnorm), and at a decreasing pair brms's dcumulative() returns a NEGATIVE category probability (4 of 20 cells at seed 238), which its closed-form helper reproduces; frmtmb's cumulative builds the categories from the threshold gaps and returns NaN with a warning, in categories on either side of the decreasing pair (at draw 5 of bin2-probe3.txt categories 1 and 2 are NaN where brms's category 1 is 0.805). With sorted thresholds every cell agrees, and sratio, cratio and acat agree everywhere, to 2.2e-16 or better (dev/remeasure-bin2-probe3.R, log dev/remeasure-out/probe/bin2-probe3.txt). A fit never reaches decreasing thresholds: frmtmb's threshold map orders them

the statement is one loop of 8 assertions; recorded whole it does not hold, and dev/brmsport-bin2-split.tsv gives each line its verdict: brms's block draws its array x = thres - eta unsorted (rnorm), so for cumulative a decreasing pair gives brms's inv_link_cumulative() a NEGATIVE probability, which frmtmb's cumulative returns as NaN: the identity holds in 16 of 32 iterations, the ordered-threshold domain limit of distributions:238. a known parameterization divergence (findings R6, fix round 2): the reference brms:::dcom_poisson() takes mu = lambda^(1 / shape), while frmtmb's compois mu is the mean (RTMB::dcompois2), so the two log densities differ at the same numbers (max 94 log units at the block's seed; at mu = 3, shape = 2 brms's mean is 2.737, dev/remeasure-bin2-probe2.R section 6). The row's text reaches brms:::, so the harness records it and does not run it
